description: Produce a standard-library Python module that flattens a nested object into dotted-path keys, plus pytest tests. Choose this when a nested object must become single-level dotted-path keys, leaving lists as leaves. Do not choose this if you need lists indexed into keys (a.0, a.1) or a custom separator: the template fixes the behaviour. Example requests: Write a Python module that flattens a nested object into dotted-path keys, with tests. | I need nested JSON flattened to single-level keys like a.b.c. | Generate a flattening module and prove it with pytest.
